classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve, compare, and rank representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0034021) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0034487) activities, supplemented by InterPro family IPR023532 for broader phylogenetic coverage, then rank by integrated sequence properties.
assumptions: GO:0034021 encodes ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase molecular function (NAXD-type) in UniProtKB/GO; if this ID returns 0 reviewed entries the closest parent term covering NAD(P)HX hydrate dehydration should be substituted
GO:0034487 encodes NADPHX epimerase molecular function (NAXE-type) in UniProtKB/GO; same fallback applies
IPR023532 captures the NAD(P)HX repair superfamily at the InterPro level, providing broader taxonomic coverage than reviewed GO-annotated entries alone
Reviewed (Swiss-Prot) entries are used for GO retrievals to maximise annotation reliability; InterPro retrieval includes unreviewed entries to maximise family coverage
mmseqs2_gpu accepts FASTA output paths from upstream nodes as target_db; VPA runtime handles MMseqs2 index construction where needed
sequence_analysis characterises composition, charge, and motifs for each functional sub-family independently; per-residue annotations are included for active-site and cofactor-binding motif discovery
rank_designs integrates GO-subset analyses and cross-family similarity hit records to score and rank the full InterPro candidate set
No structural data is required or available at this stage; ranking is sequence-property-based only
Typical NAD(P)HX repair protein length is 280-400 aa; no length filter is applied to avoid excluding divergent archaeal or plant orthologs

success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences for GO:0034021 returns ≥1 reviewed sequence
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences for GO:0034487 returns ≥1 reviewed sequence
success_criteria.dehydratase_similarity_search_completed: mmseqs2_gpu cross-search of GO:0034021 sequences against IPR023532 family completes with ≥1 hit
success_criteria.epimerase_similarity_search_completed: mmseqs2_gpu cross-search of GO:0034487 sequences against IPR023532 family completes with ≥1 hit
success_criteria.sequence_analyses_completed: sequence_analysis produces composition, charge, region, and per-residue annotation profiles for both GO-annotated sub-families
success_criteria.candidates_ranked: rank_designs returns top-20 ranked candidates from the IPR023532 family with integrated scores derived from sequence analyses and similarity hits
